outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /etc/os-release | head -5
which nginx || echo "nginx not installed"
ls /etc/nginx/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no nginx dir"
ls /etc/nginx/conf.d/ 2>/dev/null
ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
echo test > /tmp/persist_test.txt
mkdir -p /opt/testdir && echo hi > /opt/testdir/x
ls -la /workspace
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cat /tmp/persist_test.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "tmp not persisted"
mount | grep -E ' / | /workspace| /etc| /var| /tmp' 
touch /etc/testwrite 2>&1 && echo "etc writable" || echo "etc read-only"
touch /var/testwrite 2>&1 && echo "var writable" || echo "var read-only"
id
ls -ld /workspace /var/www 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || echo "no /app"
ls -la /root 2>/dev/null
find / -maxdepth 3 -iname '*task*' -o -iname '*test*' 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '^/(proc|sys|usr|var/lib|var/cache)' | head -50
cat /workspace/lost+found 2>/dev/null || true
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /opt/testbed-src
find /opt/testbed-src -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -100
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mount -o remount,rw / 2>&1 && echo "remount ok" || echo "remount failed"
touch /etc/testwrite 2>&1 && echo "etc writable now" || echo "etc still ro"
grep -E 'CapEff|CapBnd' /proc/self/status
which apt-get apt dpkg 2>/dev/null
ls /var/lib/nginx 2>/dev/null || true
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
env | sort
echo "----"
ls -la /root/.cache
find /root /tmp /run /var -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50
echo "----block devices----"
lsblk 2>/dev/null || true
cat /proc/mounts
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /tmp/guest-agent/
file /tmp/guest-agent/* 2>/dev/null
cat /tmp/guest-agent/ga-cmd-5 2>/dev/null | head -100
ls -la /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin 2>/dev/null | head -50
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /etc/init.d 2>/dev/null | head
cat /etc/inittab 2>/dev/null
ls -la /etc/rc.local /etc/rcS.d 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rIl '/workspace' /etc /usr/local /opt 2>/dev/null | head -20
ps aux | head -30
cat /proc/1/cmdline | tr '\0' ' '; echo
ls -la /usr/local/bin/normalizer; cat /usr/local/bin/normalizer
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
file /usr/local/bin/agent
strings /usr/local/bin/agent | grep -iE 'workspace|startup|snapshot|setup\.sh|/app|persist|moca|task' | sort -u | head -80
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
grep -aoE '[ -~]{6,}' /usr/local/bin/agent | grep -iE 'workspace|startup|snapshot|setup\.sh|/app|persist|moca|testbed|readonly|read-only' | sort -u | head -100
EOF
sbx --help 2>&1 | head -80; echo ====; sbx run --help 2>&1 | head -80; echo ====; which sbx; file $(which sbx)

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/base
mount -o ro /dev/vda /mnt/base
echo "base mounted"; ls /mnt/base/var/lib/dpkg/status && echo dpkg-ok
mkdir -p /tmp/ov/etc-upper /tmp/ov/etc-work /tmp/ov/var-upper /tmp/ov/var-work /tmp/ov/usr-upper /tmp/ov/usr-work /tmp/ov/run-upper /tmp/ov/run-work
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/mnt/base/etc,upperdir=/tmp/ov/etc-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/etc-work /etc
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/mnt/base/var,upperdir=/tmp/ov/var-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/var-work /var
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/mnt/base/usr,upperdir=/tmp/ov/usr-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/usr-work /usr
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/mnt/base/run,upperdir=/tmp/ov/run-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/run-work /run
echo "overlays mounted"
touch /etc/testwrite && echo etc-writable
apt-get update -qq && echo "apt update ok"
apt-get install -y -qq nginx >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1 || { echo "apt install failed"; tail -30 /tmp/apt-install.log; }
which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1 || true
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/base
mount -o ro /dev/vda /tmp/base
echo "base mounted"; ls /tmp/base/var/lib/dpkg/status && echo dpkg-ok
mkdir -p /tmp/ov/etc-upper /tmp/ov/etc-work /tmp/ov/var-upper /tmp/ov/var-work /tmp/ov/usr-upper /tmp/ov/usr-work /tmp/ov/run-upper /tmp/ov/run-work
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/tmp/base/etc,upperdir=/tmp/ov/etc-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/etc-work /etc
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/tmp/base/var,upperdir=/tmp/ov/var-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/var-work /var
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/tmp/base/usr,upperdir=/tmp/ov/usr-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/usr-work /usr
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/tmp/base/run,upperdir=/tmp/ov/run-upper,workdir=/tmp/ov/run-work /run
echo "overlays mounted"
touch /etc/testwrite && echo etc-writable
apt-get update -qq && echo "apt update ok"
apt-get install -y -qq nginx >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1 || { echo "apt install failed"; tail -30 /tmp/apt-install.log; }
which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1 || true
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
nohup bash -c 'while true; do date >> /workspace/heartbeat; sleep 1; done' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo $! > /workspace/pid
echo "started $(cat /workspace/pid)"
date
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
date
cat /workspace/pid 2>/dev/null
p=$(cat /workspace/pid 2>/dev/null); [ -d /proc/$p ] && echo "process alive" || echo "process gone"
tail -5 /workspace/heartbeat 2>/dev/null
wc -l /workspace/heartbeat 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
rm -f /workspace/heartbeat /workspace/pid
echo "--- /workspace ---"
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path '*/lost+found/*' -printf '%p\n' | sort
echo "--- nginx in fresh VM ---"
command -v nginx || echo "not installed in this fresh VM"
EOF
